The *Saṅkapparāgajātaka* (Ja 251), titled *Thoughts of Lust*, is a canonical birth story preserved in the Pali Jātaka collection [SuttaCentral]. According to its traditional introductory framework, the Buddha related this story while dwelling at Jetavana with reference to a backsliding monk, beginning with the opening phrase “No archer” [SuttaCentral].
